answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21155 Country: India Title: I heard a brief of hadith which says that offspring of the couple married within close relatives often prove to be weaker or having genetic disorders. And the wordings of hadith quoted by my Aalim friend were as follows "Innal walada la-ahwal...." however he couldn't find the complete hadith and it's source. Can you please affirm this hadith, it's correctness and the source with proper tradition. This might be from Mishkat Al-Masabih. Question: Assalamu Alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh! I heard a brief of hadith which says that offspring of the couple married within close relatives often prove to be weaker or having genetic disorders. And the wordings of hadith quoted by my Aalim friend were as follows "Innal walada la-ahwal...." however he couldn't find the complete hadith and it's source. Can you please affirm this hadith, it's correctness and the source with proper tradition. This might be from Mishkat Al-Masabih. Jazakallahu Khairah Answer ID: 21155 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 739/596/B=1431) This is the hadith of Bukhari and Muslim, which the author of Mishkat has quoted in his book: عن جابر قال كانت اليهود تقول إذا إتى الرجل امرأته من دبرها فى قبلها كان الولد أحول فنزلت: نِسَآؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَّكُمْ فَأْتُواْ حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ متفق عليه . مشكوة ص:275 ، كتاب النكاح باب المباشرة . Hadhrat Jabir ( رضى الله عنه ) reported that the Jews used to say: When a man has intercourse with his wife from rear but through the vagina, the child will have squint, so the verse was revealed: "Your wives are your tilth; go then unto your tilth as you may desire". (2:223) Both the methods are correct i.e. either having intercourse through the vagina from backside or from the front side. The saying of Jews is not correct. To get married in near relatives is not preferred, it is another hadith. You intermixed both of them in each other. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
